openai/grade-school-math.note: Archived GSM8K source is a stable math dataset, not an abandoned runnable application. Dataset scope conditions remain separate.

google-research-datasets/education-dialo.note: Archived teacher-student dialogue data remains relevant for tutor research. Archival status does not establish data obsolescence.

thu-keg/edukg.note: A K-12 educational knowledge graph remains in scope despite the 2022 last push. Availability, data currency and conditions need separate checks.

allenai/scifact.note: Scientific claim-verification data and models are relevant research materials despite the 2023 last push.

openai/skills.note: The official README marks this catalog deprecated and directs current examples to openai/plugins. Immutable pinned Skill references may remain included as historical source material; floating old catalog entries require migration review.

hkuds/deeptutor.note: Exact primary repository identifies lifelong personalized tutoring and recent activity. No application runtime test was performed.

judyess/k12.note: README describes a personal school-contact marketing scraper and explicitly says it was stopped when a dependency became defunct. Preserve history, hide from reusable defaults.

imdhiru/backlinks.note: README is a list of auto-approved comment backlinks. It does not supply an educational, research or administration resource.

harshamv/bangalore-startups-companies-li.note: A commercial company list mentions education companies but supplies no open learning artifact or reusable implementation.

marauderxtreme/video-game-radiostation-p.note: Metadata describes recreation of game radio playlists on music platforms. No learning or agent-building role is documented.

radubogdan/node-offliberty.note: The 2018 service adapter was recalled through k12.example-host text. A media-ingestion use case is possible, but current service compatibility was not checked.

atharva-k12/typing-test.note: Typing practice can be relevant. No description or current reuse instructions are present in the collected metadata, so the 2021 project is not automatically rejected.

daniel-reynolds-k12/python-random-quote.note: Metadata links an introductory Python course exercise. Owner-name K12 is not a confirmed education capability, but the exercise may retain learning value.

openai/plugins.note: Current replacement named by the deprecated OpenAI Skills catalog. Individual component conditions and runtime compatibility remain separate.
